mapper.select: select a.contract_date ,a.seq ,dbo.getUserName(a.manager_id) as managerName ,dbo.getClientName(a.client_id) as clientName ,a.attach_file_id ,a.manager_id ,a.client_id ,a.client_no ,a.vat_type ,a.contract_id ,a.set_Yn from tb_contract_mst a where a.contract_id = #{contractId}

select a.po_no ,a.item_cd ,b.item_name ,b.spec ,d.code as prod_type ,a.order_type ,a.qty ,a.unit_price ,a.supply_price ,a.vat_price ,isnull(a.supply_price, 0)+ isnull(a.vat_price, 0) as totPrice ,a.delivery_req_date ,a.degree ,a.status_type ,a.etc ,a.contract_id ,a.contract_item_id from tb_contract_item a inner join tb_item_mst b on b.item_cd = a.item_cd left join tb_common_code d on b.item_grp2 = d.code and d.com_type_cd = 'ITEM_GRP2' where a.contract_id = #{contractId}
select order_plan_id ,po_no ,type_cd ,seq ,plan_date ,item_type ,qty from tb_order_plan_type where po_no = #{poNo} and type_cd = #{typeCd}
mapper.update:
MERGE tb_order_plan_check AS T USING ( SELECT #{poNo} AS po_no, #{value} AS val ) AS S ON T.po_no = S.po_no
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
T.advance_pay_yn = S.val
T.prod_sheet = S.val
T.m1_yn = S.val
T.m2_yn = S.val
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( po_no, advance_pay_yn, prod_sheet, m1_yn, m2_yn ) VALUES ( S.po_no,
S.val NULL ,
S.val NULL ,
S.val NULL ,
S.val NULL
);
mapper.select: select a.proc_order_date ,b.make_no ,b.lot_no ,a.po_no from TB_WORK_ORDER_PROC a join TB_WORK_ORDER_BATCH b on a.work_batch_id = b.work_batch_id where a.proc_cd = #{procCd} and a.po_no = #{poNo} order by a.proc_order_date

select dbo.getCommonName('item_Type_cd', i.item_type_cd ) as itemTypeName ,id.mat_Name as matName ,case when i.item_type_cd = 'M1' then b.real_content else b.qty end as requiredQuantity ,case when i.item_type_cd = 'M1' then b.real_content * ci.qty / 100 else b.qty * ci.qty / 100 end as reqQty ,case when i.item_type_cd = 'M1' and i.item_grp1 = 'RWM02' then '사급' when i.item_type_cd in ('M2', 'M7')and i.item_grp1 = 'RWM04' then '사급' when i.item_type_cd in ('M2', 'M7')and i.item_grp1 = 'RWM03' then '자급' end orderType from tb_contract_item ci join tb_bom_mst a on ci.item_cd = a.item_cd join tb_bom_recipe b on a.bom_id = b.bom_id join tb_item_mst i on i.item_cd = b.item_cd join tb_item_detail id on id.item_cd = i.item_cd where a.default_yn ='Y' and a.item_cd = #{itemCd} and i.item_type_cd in ('M1', 'M2', 'M7')
